verdict.rationale: Render's only edge-related evidence is a global CDN that caches and serves static assets closer to users (render-docs-19), and the community notes free static sites (render-comm-1). That gets static frontend code near end users, but nothing shows application code executing on a distributed edge network. missing for 10: edge compute or edge functions that run code at global points of presence, multi-region deployment of services, documentation of edge locations or latency routing, independent corroboration.
